sections.title: Master's Independent Study
sections.description: For Data Science Master's students. Involves coursework and class presentations. A DATS 5990 project will invariably include formally gradable work comparable to that in a CIS 5000 level course. Students should discuss with the faculty supervisor the scope of the Independent Study, expectations, work involved, etc.
